answer: Five jurors re-run the task; the odd output loses the bond, and any identity-link attempt resets standing to zero when the graph catches it. Idle accounts bleed 12 percent an epoch, so a parked cluster decays before it can be sold. The epoch beacon fixes the sampling seed, so nobody picks their own jurors. A raven can repeat a name but not a signed execution trace. Cost: one bond per clone, proxy retainers, and an ocean of epochs before anything vests. Not clever, just expensive.
